title: Geek Bar Pulse Fcuking Fabulous 15000 Disposable Vape
description:
Geek Bar Pulse Fcuking Fabulous 15000 Disposable Vape
A new age of disposable vaping devices is introduced with the Fcuking Fab Geek Bar Pulse 15000 Disposable Vape, which combines state-of-the-art technology with a delicious explosion of taste. With its multiple power modes, the standard mode maximizes taste consistency and prolongs battery life by delivering an amazing 15,000 puffs using a mesh coil. For a stronger experience, switch to pulse mode, which increases output and airflow to 20W, producing denser smoke and a more flavorful experience for up to 7,500 puffs.
Unmatchable Experience
With each draw, this disposable vaporizer’s potent 5% nicotine concentration provides a pleasant sensation. The 16ml e-liquid capacity that comes preloaded guarantees a longer vaping session before requiring refill. Long-term usage is supported by the 650mAh built-in battery, which is conveniently recharged via the USB Type-C connector.
The Fcuking Fab Geek Bar Pulse 15000 skillfully blends simplicity and performance with its user-friendly draw-activated mechanism and integrated twin mesh coil, guaranteeing a fantastic vaping getaway for aficionados.
Review of FCUKING FAB Flavor
Savor the seduction of Fcuking Fab taste, a lavish concoction that tantalizes the senses. A blend of distinct and lively notes are revealed on the inhale, providing a taste profile that is both complex and gratifying. As you exhale, the lasting sweetness creates a lasting impact that makes every puff a very enjoyable experience.
What’s included:
1 Geek Bar Pulse rechargeable device
USB Type-C Cable is not included
5% salt nicotine
Volume: 16ml (up to 15,000 puffs)
Battery Capacity: 650mAh
Dual Mesh Coil
Ingredients:
Vegetable Glycerin
Propylene Glycol
Natural & Artificial Flavors
Nicotine (5% by volume)
FAQ
What is the Geek Bar Pulse Fcuking Fab 15000 Disposable Vape?
The Geek Bar Pulse Fcuking Fab 15000 is a high-capacity disposable vape device featuring multiple power modes, a large e-liquid capacity, and a built-in rechargeable battery. It offers up to 15,000 puffs in standard mode and 7,500 puffs in pulse mode.
Is the e-liquid preloaded?
Yes, the device comes preloaded with 16ml of e-liquid, ensuring a long vaping session without the need for a refill.
What flavors are available?
The Fcuking Fab flavor is a lavish concoction with distinct and lively notes, providing a complex and gratifying taste profile with lasting sweetness on the exhale.
What is included with the purchase of the Geek Bar Pulse Fcuking Fab?
The package includes one Geek Bar Pulse rechargeable device. A USB Type-C cable for recharging the battery is not included and must be purchased separately.
